cues.zh: 答案顯然是不行。

cues.en: And let's see what the problem is.
cues.zh: 看看問題在哪裡。

cues.en: The error is no algorithms are implemented to solve this equation here.
cues.zh: 錯誤是，沒有實作可求解這個方程式的演算法。

cues.en: So basically SIM has tried to solve this equation, but it could not.
cues.zh: 基本上，SymPy 已經嘗試解這個方程式，但解不出來。

cues.en: It gave up.
cues.zh: 它放棄了。

cues.en: You can see here is trying to compute the derivative.
cues.zh: 可以看到，它正在嘗試計算導數。

cues.en: This is the derivative of cosine squared and this must be one of the B values.
cues.zh: 這是 cos(x²) 的導數，而這裡一定有某個 b 值。

cues.en: So we saw that there are functions that cannot be solved or at least cannot easily be solved using the code that we have written.
cues.zh: 所以我們看到了，有些函數無法使用目前寫出的程式碼求解，或者至少很難求解。

cues.en: Now, the goal here is not to come up with some increasingly complicated workaround or set of workarounds in sympathy.
cues.zh: 這裡的目標，不是想出在 SymPy 裡越來越複雜的變通方法。

cues.en: Instead, what we are going to do is switch to NumPy and compute numerical approximations of the.
cues.zh: 我們要改用 NumPy，計算數值近似解。
